analyst_view.overall: Early view: Heerenveen have won five in a row, including 5-3 against Feyenoord, with a defence that eredivisie.nl credits for their rise. Fortuna sit 7th after a run of draws and Danny Buijs is worried about injuries, saying the squad is being overworked.

goals.text: The numbers say 3 goals. Fortuna draw a lot but conceded two set-piece goals against Telstar, and Heerenveen have scored freely; these cancel out, so I keep the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners. Nothing in the news changes how these teams play, so I see no reason to move.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.7 cards. Two disciplined mid-table sides with no rivalry; Heerenveen coach Robin Veldman's own booking at Feyenoord was a one-off.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.6 shots. I lean slightly higher because Heerenveen's attack is in its best form of the season and Fortuna will need to attack at home.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. With Heerenveen's attack sharp and Fortuna's defence stretched by injuries, I lean slightly higher.
